label: A non-real CONTAINED_IN_1 stand-in of a non-present candidate is about that candidate
paraphrase: OPEN content premise, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every bearer b with a favouring determination of profile phi, every scenario s and candidate x not a present input at s, if b's stand-in for x is contained in b (CONTAINED_IN_1) without being a real constituent of b, then that stand-in is about x (it represents x, DEF 3ece6dfe). It is a restricted form: it concerns only non-real contained stand-ins of non-present candidates, but it ranges over every bearer and every favouring the bearer has, not only actual roots, good-general favourings or the witnessed pair, so it is not the weakest form the route needs. A template reading denies it: a mode individuates its candidate only as whatever would match it, without representing it.
